title: arenaria serpyllifolia var. neelgherrensis
intro: Arenaria serpyllifolia var. neelgherrensis, commonly known as Mountain Sandwort, is a plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sandwort include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
